 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the non-background pattern tile into every region divided by 4-lines."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full-width/full-height separator lines, excluding background-colored cells.
    bg = grid[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v != bg for v in row)]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + horizontal + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + vertical + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1:
                regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # The tile with the most non-background cells is the pattern source.
    source = max(regions, key=lambda b: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(b[0], b[1]) for c in range(b[2], b[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            for c in range(c0, c1):
                out[r][c] = pattern[(r-r0) % len(pattern)][(c-c0) % len(pattern[0])]
    return out
